errors.text_span: При плътната сива линия се забелязва участък на почти липсваща промяна между 2019 г. и 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The gray line shows a clear increase between 2019 (approx. 180,000) and 2020 (approx. 195,000). Describing this as 'almost no change' is a significant exaggeration of the visual information; the slope only decreases but the line is still rising.
The final value for the gray line in 2022 is closer to 245,000, making 240,000 an inaccurate approximation.
